# Lorna Vane

[Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian)

## Appearance

Lorna Vane is a bright and lovely woman with ocean-blue eyes. She possesses a magnificent head of glowing hair that cascades down to her feet like a fountain, shimmering like liquid gold and glistening like fire in the light. Her hands are brown and work-hardened.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LORNA RETURNS P16](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0016), +2 more_

## Personality

Lorna Vane possesses a sharp wit, though she is not particularly inclined toward socializing. Driven by a deep desire for motherhood and a strong sense of duty to complete any obligation she undertakes, she is also highly skilled in hand-stitching and fine embroidery. She plans to move to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) in the autumn to pursue nursing and shape her own future.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P32](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0032)_

## History

Lorna Vane endured a history of grief and hardship from an early age, being twelve years old when her brother died and fourteen when she discovered her father's hanged body following his suicide. Left with enough money for a single year at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), she later returned to teach at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) school and entered a twelve-year marriage. Lorna eventually formed a friendship with her neighbor, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), visiting her home and joining group gatherings at the local lighthouse. Despite experiencing intense envy over her past tragedies, Lorna confessed her bitterness to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), solidifying a deep, lifelong bond between them. Lorna later fell secretly in love with author [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), though she was left heartbroken when he departed after finishing a novel. Her life took a dramatic turn when she traveled to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery for her husband, [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), only to discover that the man she had been living with for twelve years was actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus had died years prior in Cuba. Following this revelation and Laurence's identity recovery, Lorna returned home in grief and exhaustion, supported by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Adrian eventually returned to declare his love for Lorna, receiving a blessing from Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md), and shared plans to purchase Nell's former cottage for their future summer holidays.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P46](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), +41 more_

## Quotes

> "My loveliness is something I despise. My desire is that I had perpetually been as dark-skinned and ordinary as the darkest-skinned and most ordinary female in that fishing village across the way. So, how do you regard Miss Winifred?"
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P31](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0031)

> "Had I been aware, I’d have left—I’d not have remained in this place to encounter him. You ought to have informed me. You weren’t being fair, Nell—oh, you weren’t being fair!"
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P47](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0047)

> “Though I have resided beneath its roof for merely a month,” Lorna said, “my affection for it surpasses any love I felt for the house across the way, where my entire life was spent.”
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P3](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0003)

> "Nell prefers the pink ones, whereas Hugh favors the white. However, I desire the crimson ones. No other flower fulfills a particular longing within me the way they do."
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P5](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0005)

> "Its magnitude feels impossible—I fear giving it voice—or dwelling on it. I feel as though this is merely one more illusion born of this dwelling of phantoms, bound to disappear the moment I depart."
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P29](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0029)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--lorna-vane.md)

[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and Lorna Vane met when he moved into the Vane house, where he was immediately struck by her beauty. After spending a summer together with friends while he worked on a book, Lorna fell secretly in love with him and was left heartbroken when he departed. However, Adrian later returned to declare his love for her, and the two became romantically involved.
